notes.subject: און אפס מעשיהם
notes.rationale: word order read two ways: 'their works are nothing' (KJV) vs 'nothing are their works' attributing emptiness to the idols themselves (ASV/JPS)

notes.subject: נסכיהם
notes.rationale: נסך means both 'libation' and 'cast (metal) idol'; rendered here as molten images

notes.subject: רוח ותהו
notes.rationale: tohu echoes Gen 1:2's formless waste, applied to idols — wind and wild-emptiness

notes.subject: ye
notes.rationale: Bambara equative 'ye…ye' supplied where Hebrew has no verb 'to be'

translation: Anw! u bɛɛ ⟨ye⟩ fɛn yelenw ⟨ye⟩; u ka baaraw ye foyiwali ⟨ye⟩; u ka santonbatofɛnw ye fiɲɛ ni daji ye.
